peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 0.7% above its local comparables; 30 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.8): 5.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 29 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 91.7% of months (24 months).

positions.label: Recent market activity
positions.statement: Recent market activity — Below peers (2.0): condo and EC resales within 2 km −24.7%, latest 12 months against the prior 12: higher than 1 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: planning-area private resales −23.4%. Observed activity, not a prediction.

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2012.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

householdIncome.geographyNote: Bishan planning area (Master Plan 2019), not a postal district.
householdIncome.incomeDefinition: Income is household employment income including employer CPF.
conditions: Employment income includes employer CPF and platform-worker CPF contributions
Figures are rounded to the nearest 100 and may not add up
Small cells should be read with caution
householdIncome.context: This describes the area, not buyers.
